title: Lena and the Postcard
author: Mara Okonkwo
blurb: Dominic Hartwell, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
